question: The Bailadila range of Chhattisgarh is famous for which of the following minerals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron Ore**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bailadila range, located in the southern part of Chhattisgarh, is renowned for its high-quality iron ore deposits.
 
• Mining activities in the region are significant due to the presence of this mineral.
 
• In fact, these hills contain some of the largest and the purest iron ore reserves in the entire country.
 
• With more than 14 identified deposits, iron ore from Bailadila is largely exported to Japan and Korea besides various other countries.
 
• Bailadila is a complex group of hills with high-grade iron ore deposits that spans the Dantewada district of Chhattisgarh.
 
• It is so named because its shape is like that of a hump of an ox, with 'Baila' meaning 'ox' and 'Dila' meaning 'hump' in the local language.
